_comment: Per-window-kind layout for TP messages. The kind is the fuki_kind byte
of each message's INF1 attributes (see window_kinds.py / TAGS.md).
warn_width / max_width limit line width in font px. The value "auto"
calibrates the limit from the project's ORIGINAL text: the widest
original line of the same window kind (originals always fit the real
game box); warn is auto-max minus 20. null = use the global plugin
settings; a number = fixed limit. Explicit per-string overrides always
win. font_file picks the BFN font for the kind (empty = default font).
lines_per_page drives preview pagination and the page-height scale.
An optional 'name' labels the kind in the editor (preview badge and the
Window: label). Unknown kinds show as 'Dialogue (kind N)' - to classify
one (e.g. the ring-menu item info screen), add its number here.
